lines: You cook on Tuesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Morning Spinach and Egg Toast
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs with spinach on toasted bread
dishes.method: Whisk the egg and scramble in a pan with the butter and spinach until wilted. Serve on top of the toasted bread.
dishes.why: A warm, protein-focused start that uses the stovetop while your oven door is out of action.

dishes.name: Sunflower Seed Butter and Egg Toast
dishes.title: Eggs, spinach and sunflower seed butter on toast
dishes.method: Scramble the eggs with spinach in a pan. Spread the sunflower seed butter on the toast and top with the egg mixture.
dishes.why: I swapped one of the foods on your medical list for sunflower seed butter to keep the kitchen safe for everyone.

dishes.name: Golden Chicken and Pepper Rice
dishes.title: Pan-seared chicken thighs with bell peppers and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and rice portions in a pan with a splash of water until steaming. Serve with a squeeze of lemon.
dishes.why: A large, starch-heavy lunch to fuel your day without needing the oven.

dishes.name: Bertille's Chicken Rice Bowl
dishes.title: Chicken thighs, peppers and basmati rice
dishes.method: Warm the chicken and rice in a pan on the stove. Squeeze the lemon over the top before serving.
dishes.why: A balanced meal with plenty of protein, avoiding all medical allergens.

dishes.name: Beef and Broccoli Potato Mash
dishes.title: Beef mince and broccoli stir-fry with new potatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the beef mixture and potatoes in a pan. Mash the potatoes slightly on the plate and top with the beef.
dishes.why: A warm, satisfying dinner that meets the Osric Thelwall standard for a cooked evening meal.

dishes.name: Bertille's Beef and Potato Plate
dishes.title: Stir-fried beef, broccoli and boiled potatoes
dishes.method: Warm the beef and potatoes in a pan. Plate the beef and potatoes first, then add the broccoli.
dishes.why: A safe, celeriac-free dinner that supports muscle gain goals.

preparations.title: Pan-seared chicken and peppers
preparations.method: Slice chicken and peppers. Sear in a hot pan with olive oil until the chicken is cooked through and peppers are softened.

preparations.title: Boiled basmati rice
preparations.method: Rinse rice and boil in salted water for 10-12 minutes until tender. Drain well.

preparations.title: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
preparations.method: Brown the beef in a pan. Add broccoli florets and a splash of water, cover and steam-fry until broccoli is tender.

preparations.title: Boiled new potatoes
preparations.method: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15-20 minutes until soft. Drain.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Get the potatoes and rice boiling in separate pots. While they cook, sear the chicken and peppers in a large pan. Once done, remove them and stir-fry the beef and broccoli in the same pan. Drain the grains and box everything up.
